content: Models trained on the basis of minimising errors for imbalanced datasets tend to more frequently predict the majority class; achieving high accuracy in such cases can be misleading. Because of this, the macro-averaged F-score, chosen for this competition, is a more suitable metric as it weights the performance on each class equally.
